terra.problem: Saying Adoni-zedek calls every king he can reach goes beyond the text. It names four kings he contacts but does not say whom else he could reach.
Saying the text never has the king leave Jerusalem is misleading: the five kings advance and camp before Gibeon. The text does not say he moves all his people out of Jerusalem.
The explanation is flat and repetitive. Its last sentence restates that confusion is the answer without adding insight or Papa Dorin's personality.
